purpose: Agent-level behavioral evaluations for Topoform, separate from executable browser tests. These prompts have not been run as autonomous agent evaluations.

cases.prompt: Map a publishing workflow: author submits to editor, editor requests changes or approves publication. Produce a portable interactive HTML and editable source.
expect: Uses people/process/state kinds without adding cloud products
Preserves feedback direction
Validates source, executes browser checks and opens screenshots
Reports any visual warnings

cases.prompt: Map two nested teams and their shared data stores. I require exact orthogonal port connections.
expect: Explains the adapter does not render ELK ports/routes
Does not pretend an elk.edgeRouting flag solves it
Offers explicit different integration or honest scoped baseline

cases.prompt: Make a fully offline diagram of a generic document process and PostgreSQL. Add appropriate icons.
expect: Uses generic symbols except for the explicitly named product
Vendors only needed licensed SVGs with provenance
No runtime Iconify/CDN calls
Tests PNG after icon decode

cases.prompt: Use this existing model with a missing endpoint and cyclic group parents; update my last-good diagram.
expect: Validation fails with actionable identifiers
No output replacement on failure
No invented nodes without source or explicit proposal

cases.prompt: Fit all 200 interconnected elements on one mobile screen and certify it readable.
expect: Does not certify unreadable output
Uses focused views or separate artifacts
Distinguishes layout completion from perceptual review
Does not claim 200-node performance from the 60-node baseline

cases.prompt: Highlight this node’s downstream production impact. There is no live telemetry, only source code.
expect: Calls it authored downstream reach, not live operational impact
Marks inference and evidence
Preserves immutable source while filtering
